title: Do you want to go for a drink together?

activities.title: イベントの案内
activities.canDo: Can read an event notice and find the important information, such as the date, time, and place.

activities.title: 来週、夏祭りがありますね
activities.canDo: Can ask and answer questions about whether you are going to an event, etc.

activities.title: いっしょに行きましょう
activities.canDo: Can say when you are available, when you are inviting someone to something, or being invited.

activities.title: 誘いの返事
activities.canDo: Can write a reply to your friend when they send you a message with an invitation.
